newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open slightly higher.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were seen opening slightly higher Monday, in line with LME copper prices, after a fall in LME warehouse copper stocks.
COMEX July was seen opening unchanged to up 0.30 cent a pound from Friday's close at 111.60 cents, after trading a 111.50-112.25 cent range in overnight ACCESS trade.
LME copper stocks fell 1,750 tonnes Monday to 151,600 tonnes, while COMEX copper stocks were down 1,127 short tons Friday to 42,645 short tons.
The weakness of the U.S. dollar was also likely to boost demand from the Far East, traders said.

The uptrend in COMEX July copper since mid-April was still intact, traders said, with the July/September spread remaining firmly in backwardation around 3.20 cents a pound, even though the LME cash-to-three month spread has eased in recent weeks.
